title.en: Papuan supply carriers on the Kokoda Trail
title.zh: 科科达小径上的巴布亚补给搬运工

alt.en: Men carrying suspended boxes cross a narrow wooden bridge over a forest stream, with other men beside the water.
alt.zh: 几名男子肩挑悬挂的箱子穿过林间溪流上的狭窄木桥，另有人站在水边。

caption.en: Papua, November 1942. The AWM identifies Papuan carriers transporting supplies toward Wairopi on the northern Kokoda Trail, with Australian soldiers nearby.
caption.zh: 巴布亚，1942年11月。澳大利亚战争纪念馆将画面人物记为沿科科达小径北段向怀罗皮运输补给的巴布亚搬运工，附近还有澳大利亚士兵。

interpretation.en: Supply boxes hang from shoulder poles above a narrow forest crossing. Papuan labour sustained a campaign whose routes vehicles could not reach. The accompanying account places this work alongside documented conscription, poor conditions and later demands for recognition.
interpretation.zh: 补给箱悬在肩挑木杆上，越过林间窄桥。巴布亚劳动者维系了车辆无法抵达山区的战役补给。关联故事同时呈现史料中的征发、恶劣条件与后来的承认诉求。

note.en: The item record identifies this photograph as public domain. The Australian War Memorial permits reproduction of its public-domain images.
note.zh: 单件记录将此照片标为公有领域，澳大利亚战争纪念馆允许复制其公有领域图像。

transformation.zh: 官方JPEG原样保存，包括馆方署名条。

title.en: The “Fuzzy Wuzzy Angels”: looking beyond the myth

title.zh: 广岛重建中的儿童游戏

alt.en: Two children play on a wooden seesaw amid rubble, with a row of buildings behind them.
alt.zh: 两名儿童在瓦砾间玩木制跷跷板，身后是一排建筑。

caption.en: Hiroshima, 1946, one year after the atomic bombing. The AWM records children playing in a heavily damaged area with recently rebuilt buildings behind them.
caption.zh: 广岛，1946年，原子弹轰炸的次年。馆藏记录将此景描述为儿童在严重受损区域玩耍，身后有新近重建的建筑。

interpretation.en: A makeshift seesaw stands between rubble and rebuilt storefronts. Photographed the year after the bombing, the scene records children using a damaged urban space while reconstruction began.
interpretation.zh: 临时跷跷板立在瓦砾与重建店铺之间。照片摄于轰炸次年，记录重建开始时儿童在受损城市空间中的活动。

title.en: Baker nuclear test at Bikini Atoll
title.zh: 比基尼环礁的贝克核试验

alt.en: An aerial photograph shows a towering explosion cloud above water, with ships and scattered clouds around it.
alt.zh: 航拍照片显示水面上升起高大的爆炸云，周围可见舰船与零散云层。

caption.en: Bikini Atoll, 25 July 1946. The AWM identifies this aerial view as the Baker nuclear test.
caption.zh: 比基尼环礁，1946年7月25日。澳大利亚战争纪念馆将此航拍画面标为贝克核试验。

interpretation.en: The explosion rises above ships placed in Bikini’s lagoon. This military aerial view records the Baker test; the linked history follows the Marshallese communities displaced by the wider testing programme and its lasting contamination.
interpretation.zh: 爆炸云升起，环礁潟湖中可见舰船。这幅军事航拍记录贝克试验；关联故事追踪更广泛试验计划造成的马绍尔社群迁移与长期污染。

title.en: Civilian assistance remembered after Singapore’s occupation
title.zh: 新加坡占领结束后被记录的平民援助

alt.en: Women and Australian servicemen stand together outside a long thatched building, talking and posing for the camera.
alt.zh: 几名妇女与澳大利亚军人站在长形茅草屋外，交谈并面向镜头。

caption.en: Singapore, 20 September 1945. The AWM identifies former prisoners of the 2/29th Australian Infantry Battalion with Chinese women workers who assisted them during captivity.
caption.zh: 新加坡，1945年9月20日。馆藏记录将这些人记为澳大利亚第2/29步兵营的前战俘及曾在其被囚期间提供帮助的华人女工。

interpretation.en: This meeting after the occupation records civilian help during captivity. The military catalogue names the battalion but leaves the women unnamed, preserving an uneven record of the people who sustained prisoners.
interpretation.zh: 占领结束后的这次会面记录被囚期间的平民援助。军事目录写明了部队番号，却未记录妇女姓名，留下了不均衡的援助者档案。

title.zh: 瓜达尔卡纳尔岛上的所罗门群岛警察

alt.en: Six Solomon Islands policemen pose with Captain Martin Clemens in a grassy field; several hold rifles.
alt.zh: 六名所罗门群岛警察与马丁·克莱门斯上尉在草地上合影，数人持有步枪。

caption.en: Guadalcanal, October 1942 according to the AWM catalogue. Captain Martin Clemens stands with members of the local police.
caption.zh: 瓜达尔卡纳尔岛，馆藏记录标注为1942年10月。马丁·克莱门斯上尉与当地警察合影。

interpretation.en: Local policemen appear alongside a British colonial officer in a campaign often told through U.S. and Japanese forces. The catalogue names Clemens but leaves the six policemen unnamed.
interpretation.zh: 当地警察与一名英国殖民官员并肩出现在常以美日军队为主角的战役之中。目录记下克莱门斯，却未记下六名警察的姓名。

title.en: The Marine Campaign for Guadalcanal: The Landing and August Battles
title.zh: 海军陆战队瓜岛战役：登陆与八月战斗

creator.zh: 国防部／海军陆战队（馆藏归属）

alt.en: Fireworks streak across the night sky above silhouetted trees and people in an open plaza.
alt.zh: 烟火划过夜空，广场上的树木和人群呈现为剪影。

caption.en: Tokyo, 1946. William Harry Freeman photographed fireworks at the Imperial Plaza celebrating promulgation of Japan’s new constitution, as identified by the AWM catalogue.
caption.zh: 东京，1946年。威廉·哈里·弗里曼拍摄了皇居前广场的烟火；馆藏记录将其记为庆祝日本新宪法公布的活动。

interpretation.en: The fireworks celebrate promulgation in 1946. The constitution came into force on 3 May 1947, after further preparation; the photograph and the legal transition therefore belong to different stages.
interpretation.zh: 烟火庆祝的是1946年的宪法公布。经过后续准备，宪法于1947年5月3日生效；照片与法律施行属于不同阶段。
